text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ――Ooooohhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross breaks away! Tamamo Cross is 
pulling ahead!! Tamamo Cross in the lead! 
She crosses the line!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I won... I really won...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm... number one in all of Japan!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, how wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the most brilliant radiance of 
the "now"... What a powerful, breathtaking 
light...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Yet I feel no fear. If anything, I find 
myself thrilled...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(Surely this is... because I realized that 
there are still so many opponents out 
there worthy of putting my whole heart and 
soul on the line to race against――)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I must reach a realm that surpasses that 
brilliance too—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. I'm back.
choice_data_list: Looks like you got a good feel for it.
Looks like you got a good feel for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While it's frustrating that we didn't 
win, we gained something far greater.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...Their strength is beyond imagination. 
And for that, I am truly delighted."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The rivals running ahead of me show me, 
like the dawn, that this is not yet my 
limit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As long as they remain beloved goals and 
rivals—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There is no bound to the limits this body 
can surpass, and the brilliance it emits, 
the trail of light it can trace, shall 
become infinitely dazzling...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I have absolute certainty of it...!

Even when clashing head-on with a superior 
rival, Mejiro Ardan's resolve does not 
waver.

Far from it, she seems to have discovered 
her own potential and is burning with even 
more fighting spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Can I— ever reach heights great enough to 
outshine them?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Your unwavering words are truly 
encouraging.

...With the Classic year nearing its end, 
the battles against her rivals will only 
become even fiercer from here on.

It might be best to take a breather before 
the next goal and focus on taking her 
abilities up another notch.
choice_data_list: Next, let's aim for the Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"It's the classic royal road race to 
determine the strongest middle-distance 
runner of the spring, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure a magnificent radiance will 
gather there once again.
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to competing already.
I'm looking forward to competing already.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Let's head back and review today's 
performance right away. I want to check 
Tamamo-san and Oguri-san's runs one more 
time.

And so, unable to contain her soaring 
excitement, I hurried back to the academy 
together with Mejiro Ardan.
And at almost the exact same time—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Tamamo Cross breaks away! Tamamo Cross 
breaks away!! Tamamo Cross is in the lead! 
She's across the finish line!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Amazing—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Ardan-san is racing on equal footing... 
with opponents this strong..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And yet... I...—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(...It's okay. I can become even 
stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: (—No. I must become stronger.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(So that when Chiyono O-san returns 
someday... I will be worthy of being her 
rival...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—The Osaka Hai. There, I will surely shine 
even brighter...!
